name: pipeline_phenanthrene
purpose: TASKS 146, build step 6 (demo run 1): the pipeline end to end on phenanthrene from its SMILES - a hold-out (a) molecule v1.3 never trained on - with its certificate, read afterwards against the corpus folder's ωB97X truth and the scaled-B3LYP baseline (probes/pipeline_vs_corpus.py A_541c53d1a5)
command: env CORPUS_QC_PYTHON=C:/Users/thebr/.conda/envs/qc/python.exe PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m m08.pipeline --name phenanthrene --smiles c1ccc2c3ccccc3ccc2c1 --out ../../probes/results_m1/pipeline_demo_2026-10-29 --threads 6 --psi4-memory-gb 4 --wsl-cap-mb 8192

estimate.basis: benzene's analytic B3LYP Hessian took 317 s on 6 laptop threads (29 Oct 22:5x) at 102 basis functions; phenanthrene has 234, and the Hessian grows about as the third to fourth power of that ratio (×12–28)

memory.basis: a bound: the WSL step runs under probes/wsl_capped.sh at 8192 MB (pyscf max_memory 7608); psi4 is given 4 GB and runs before it, not beside it; the network step loads three 1.2 MB-class checkpoints
